_provenance.source: FAA d-TPP cycle 2610 instrument approach plates for KPHL (the PDFs listed in kphl-procedures.json)
_provenance.method: Glidepath angle / TCH and the missed approach climb altitudes were read from each plate (rendered and read visually for the 15 transcribed approaches; text layer, pdfjs-dist, for the special-authorization, CAT II/III and RNP plates). HUMAN TRANSCRIPTION - verify against the PDFs before any real use.
_provenance.terms: TCH = threshold crossing height of the plate's glidepath (GS = ILS glideslope, GP = RNAV glidepath). It is NOT the VGSI TCH printed in the '(VGSI Angle x/TCH y)' note (NASR threshold_crossing_height_ft). The ILS 26 glideslope is 3.15 deg and the RNAV 35 glidepath 3.14 deg as printed.
